concerns.text: FR-001 mandates downloading 'Materials Project, OQMD, and AFLOW'. The plan (Section 2, Dataset Strategy) explicitly states: 'we cannot use the verified REST URLs for Materials Science data' and decides to 'exclude Materials Project' or 'simulate' it. This leaves FR-001 unbacked; the plan does not provide a task to satisfy the requirement of ingesting the Materials Project dataset.

SC-004 requires measuring the correlation between the compositional ImbalanceScore and performance degradation on the minority subset. The plan mentions calculating ImbalanceScore (Section 3.1) and evaluating performance (Section 3.4), but contains no explicit phase, task, or data-model entity dedicated to computing or reporting this specific correlation metric. The plan focuses on rank shifts (FR-006) and MAE changes (FR-005), but omits the correlation analysis required by SC-004.
